description: A day on the job at Tarnside Assurance. Ledgerwell Ltd has hired you to show how far a phishing and social-engineering campaign could get against their staff. They have one condition: nobody gets named and shamed. Research the company from public sources, craft spear-phishing email, build a look-alike login page, work a pretext call to the service desk, then turn the engagement round and defend against your own attack. Every outcome is explained, and there are no virtual machines.
